thesis: Q2 Holdings (NYSE: QTWO), digital banking software for banks, credit unions and fintechs. Q3 2026 10-Q (filed 2026-10-28) read in relevant sections. Q3 revenue 225.8M (+11.9%), 9M 662.0M (+12.9%); subscription 9M 550.8M (+15.2%); 9M net income 89.7M vs 31.6M; effective tax rate 6.4% (NOL shield). 9M OCF 181.7M vs 137.8M; capex 10.4M and capitalized software 21.1M; SBC 60.8M in 9M. Repaid 304.0M convertible notes in cash and bought back 158.9M of shares in 9M (shares 62.74M to 61.78M); cash 116.3M plus 6.7M investments, no debt. Close 66.50 x 61.78M = 4.11B: 37.3x TTM NI 110.2M, FCF yield 5.0% (3.1% after SBC), 6.2x book.
counterthesis: Valuation is full at 37x GAAP earnings that are flattered by a roughly 6% tax rate; FCF after SBC yield about 3%. Growth is low double digits. Bank consolidation, competition from Fiserv, Jack Henry, nCino and Alkami, and AI-driven product change could slow growth; cash fell after the buyback and note repayment.
invalidation: Invalidated by subscription growth falling toward single digits, margin gains stalling, loss of large bank customers, or buybacks that stop offsetting SBC dilution.
